meta.title: Kiln Yoga, small-group yoga studio in Peckham
meta.description: A warm studio above a bakery in Peckham with just 14 mats. Slow flow, yin, a 4 week beginners course and pregnancy yoga on Saturdays.

rationale: The room is the product: small, warm, wooden, above a bakery. So the character is a toasted paper background, terracotta accent and a soft serif, with a magazine-style opening that gives the practical facts at once and leaves the photograph to carry the mood. Services are written as plain paragraphs because each class needs a sentence of explanation, and a handwritten note and a photo strip keep it personal rather than glossy.

props.statement: A small room above a bakery in Peckham. Fourteen mats, a wooden floor, and time to slow down.
props.detail: Slow flow, yin, a 4 week beginners course and pregnancy yoga on Saturday mornings.

props.label: Who teaches here
props.title: A room small enough to feel looked after
paragraphs: I'm Mei, and I teach most of the classes at Kiln with two other teachers. We keep the room to 14 mats on purpose, so nobody is lost at the back and nobody is rushed.
The floor is wood, the windows are big, and in the mornings the bakery downstairs makes the whole studio smell of bread. It is warm in every sense. We like it that way.
We are not a gym and we are not a lifestyle brand. Come as you are, borrow a mat if you need one, and take your time.
props.pullQuote: Small on purpose, so nobody is lost at the back.

props.label: Classes
props.title: What we teach
props.intro: Four things, done slowly. Book a single class or buy a class pass.

items.name: Slow flow
items.description: Gentle linked movement with time to breathe between shapes. Warming, steady and kind to stiff shoulders.

items.name: Yin
items.description: Long, quiet holds on the floor with cushions and blankets. A good way to end a busy week.

items.name: Beginners course
items.description: Four weeks with the same small group, learning the basics without pressure. Start here if you have never done yoga or want to start again.

items.name: Pregnancy yoga
items.description: Saturday mornings, with breathing, gentle strength and plenty of rest. Open to every stage of pregnancy.

props.caption: The room, as it really is.

quote.text: It is the only class where I stop thinking about my inbox. You can smell the bread, the floor is warm, and Mei remembers everyone.

items.q: I have never done yoga. Can I just turn up?
items.a: Yes. The 4 week beginners course is the easiest way in, and any slow flow or yin class is also fine to start with. Tell the teacher it is your first time and we will look after you.

items.q: Do I need to bring a mat?
items.a: Bring your own if you have one. If not, tell us when you book and we will have one ready.

items.q: Can I book a single class?
items.a: Yes, single classes and class passes are both available. With only 14 mats, booking ahead is wise.

items.q: Is pregnancy yoga suitable for me?
items.a: The Saturday morning class is made for pregnant people. If you have any concerns, ask your midwife or doctor first and talk to Mei before your first class.

props.title: Find us above the bakery
props.address: Kiln Yoga, above the bakery, Peckham, London SE15
props.directions: Go through the bakery door and take the stairs at the back up to the studio. Please arrive five minutes early.
